Are you looking for a job in the evening where you can work long hours? This is possible at PostNL Alphen aan den Rijn! Start working as a warehouse worker, and earn a nice salary of € 14,71 per hour! Have we made you curious? Then read on!

What we offer
- A salary of € 14,71 per hour
- Shift allowances! After 22h00 you get 20%. € 17,65
- Extra money! 30% extra after 00h00. € 19,12!
- Travel expenses? We got you!
- A fun place to work with many hours!
- Opportunities to grow!

Who you are
Working hard is your thing, and you like to accept every task. Warehouse worker is totally your thing! It is also important that you:

- You speak the Dutch and/or English
- You have your own transport to get to the work location;
- You are available for a minimum of three days per week;
- You are able to lift parcels up to 20 kg;

What will you do
The job of warehouse worker at PostNL is quite easy to learn. You can do it all! It will be about sorting of the incoming parcels! First you have to put all the parcels on the assembly line. Afterwards, the sorting machine will do it's job and the parcels will be sent to the sorting department. At the sorting department, you will be sorting parcels on zip code. Easy, right? But be careful: some parcels can weigh up to 25 KG. No worries, everything will be explained to you. And there's always someone to help you! Did you learn everything after a while? Then it’s time to work on your own! There are plenty of other career opportunities too. Discover them all!

- Work from Monday from to Friday;
- Working hours from 17h30 till 02h00

Where will you work
Are you curious what the largest PostNL warehouse in the Netherlands looks like on the inside? Then get started as a warehouse worker in Alphen aan den Rijn and discover it yourself! Together with a team full of friendly colleagues, you ensure that everything runs smoothly. There is a food cart outside every day where you can get tasty snacks. Are you someone who enjoys going to the gym during the day or prefers doing your grocery shopping when it's nice and quiet? Then a career as a Line Operator could be exactly what you're looking for!

Working in shifts gives you a flexible schedule, making it feel like you have an extra day off every week. Sounds good, right?

As a line operator, you are responsible for ensuring the production process runs smoothly in a modern manufacturing environment. You will set up, operate, and monitor production machines and equipment to ensure production is carried out safely, efficiently, and in line with quality standards.

You will keep a close eye on the production process, identify any irregularities, and take action when needed. You'll also troubleshoot minor machine issues independently and perform first-line maintenance to keep operations running smoothly. In addition, you will carry out quality inspections and accurately record production data.

In this role, you'll work closely with colleagues from production, logistics, and the technical department. Maintaining high standards of hygiene, safety, and quality is an essential part of the job and the working environment.

- Accurate and quality-conscious
- Results-driven, flexible, and proactive
- A team player
- Good command of Dutch or English
